children: ExpreS2ion obtained a ~SEK 19.3M guarantee for its TO 13 warrants and entered a put option deal with Alumni Capital for up to SEK 50M, subject to EGM approval. TO 13 exercise price is SEK 1.60; the put option has a SEK 4.00 floor.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
SEK 19.3M TO 13 guarantee (≈60%)
Backstops near-term funding if warrant take-up is weak, reducing financing risk.
TO 13 exercise price SEK 1.60
Sets dilution level if exercised or via directed issue; premium to SEK 1.25 close.
Up to SEK 50M put option facility
Adds discretionary equity funding over 24 months, improving liquidity runway.
Put option floor price SEK 4.00
Facility usable only if shares trade materially higher, limiting near-term dilution.
EGM approval required
Both the guarantee mechanism and facility hinge on shareholder authorization.
Directed Issue at SEK 1.60 if needed
Ensures capital even with low warrant exercise; defines potential dilution price.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a funding backstop for a Phase I program, aligning with earlier capital raises tied to TO 13. A clear Phase I readout and securing a strategic partner would turn this optional financing into a larger catalyst.
